subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support an npm `dev` dist-tag for moving `main` snapshots, or formally make dev a git-only update channel?
rationale: Current code intentionally supports a git-based dev workflow while release publishing is tag- and provenance-gated; selecting a different npm snapshot policy changes release security, versioning, and operator responsibilities.

options.title: Make dev git-only
options.body: Document the existing git checkout flow as the sole dev-channel contract and remove wording that suggests an npm `dev` tag is expected.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add a separately versioned, protected moving-main publication pipeline with provenance, verification, retention/rollback policy, and clear non-production guidance.

recommendation.title: Make dev git-only
recommendation.body: Document the existing git checkout flow as the sole dev-channel contract and remove wording that suggests an npm `dev` tag is expected.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history and direct discussion connect this person most closely to the current npm release and development-channel contract.
